summary: The broker refuses a subscribe over REST: the reply says so per item instead of a success, and the instrument is not held, so a later subscribe asks the broker again.

notes: The web acknowledges the subscribe before it is sent: the adapter queues it for a batch and answers 'Subscription requested' (rmoney_adapter.py:431-445); the batch's refusal raises (rmoney_websocket.py:558-559) and is only logged and tried again (rmoney_adapter.py:646-653), so the client never hears of it.

A web defect the desktop does not copy (review R107-03, decisions.md 'Never copy a web defect'): an acknowledgement for something that never streams. The reply is not one of the frames web.json compares, so there is no deviation entry; the web write-up is in the lane's report.

The refusal's code and description are made up for this case: no recorded XTS refusal exists. 400 is what the feed reads as a definite refusal (brokers/families/xts/streaming.rs subscription_call); the reason is passed on as the broker gave it.
